title: cadintent basis citations
description: A command's citations: the rules, source evidence, and calculations it rests on. Closed set of four citation kinds. Whether basis may be empty is declared per command kind. Spec version 0.1.0.

RuleCitation.description: Cites a named, parameterized rule entry in an imported rule registry, pinning the exact imported version. The command carries the evaluated, quantized value in its payload; this citation records what produced it. Fold never evaluates the rule.

registry.description: The id of the imported rule registry the entry lives in.

version.description: The exact registry version imported into this project that the citation resolves against.

name.description: The rule entry's name within the registry, e.g. 'crown_from_pl'.

params.description: The parameter values the rule was evaluated with.

EvidenceCitation.description: Cites source evidence: a source-file content hash and a native entity reference within it, always bound together. A bare native handle is never a citation.

entity.description: The native entity reference within the hashed source file, e.g. a DXF handle.

CommandCitation.description: Cites an earlier entry in this project's log by its seq.

seq.description: The seq of the earlier log entry cited.

StatementCitation.description: A human assertion — the durable landing place for rules and facts stated in conversation.

BasisCitation.description: One typed citation. The closed set of four kinds: rule, evidence, command, statement.

Basis.description: A command's basis: a list of typed citations. Whether it may be empty is declared per command kind.
